description: Na₂W₄O₁₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.82 Å. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-21°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.18 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-21°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-2.30 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three W atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent W atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent W atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent W atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one W atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one W atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two W atoms.
